caves_analysis.method: whole-track mix measures; htdemucs principal stems; grid regression and 60/120/240 candidates; no human audition

scores.origin_method: sixteenth phase constrained to regressed quarter-beat phase; harmonic novelty and bass onset comparison; first-beat confidence medium

limitations: Pitch octaves below the pyin analysis range may result from octave smoothing; not verified real notes.
Forced major/minor triads are not validated harmony, especially during pitch slides and fade-out.
Residual edge drum detections are amplified by independent MIDI/WAV peak normalization.
Context grids use mix; local context bass tonics not claimed.
